spec2def(inetcomm.dll inetcomm.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(inetcomm registry inetcomm.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# inetcomm.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/inetcomm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(inetcomm_shims OBJECT imaptransport.c inetcomm_main.c internettransport.c mimeintl.c mimeole.c pop3transport.c protocol.c smtptransport.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(inetcomm_shims PRIVATE oldnames uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libole32 liboleaut32 libws2_32 libuser32 libpropsys liburlmon libmsvcrt libkernel32_vista libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(inetcomm_shims)
set(INETCOMM_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/inetcomm/inetcomm_r.o)
add_cargo_module(inetcomm inetcomm-cargo inetcomm.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS inetcomm_shims psdk inetcomm_r ${INETCOMM_REUSED} uuid_sources)
